articles.title: midas-dfxm added to PyPI
articles.summary: Dark-Field X-ray Microscopy (DFXM) uses differentiable forward and inverse methods to image bulk grains. The technique employs a magnifying objective, like CRL or MLL, placed on a diffracted X-ray beam. This advanced microscopy allows for detailed internal structural analysis, crucial for material science research and understanding material properties at a microscopic level.
